# NAMI (National Alliance on Mental Illness)

> > NAMI is the nation's largest grassroots mental health organization providing education, support, and advocacy for individuals and families affected by mental illness.

NAMI works to raise awareness, build community support, and influence policy across mental health treatment, crisis intervention, criminal justice reform, and healthcare workforce development. The organization offers educational programs, support groups, advocacy campaigns like NAMIWalks, and resources for individuals, families, youth, and healthcare professionals.

## Key Topics

- Mental health awareness and education
- Crisis intervention and Help Not Handcuffs
- Criminal justice reform and incarceration
- Healthcare workforce development and provider shortages
- Patient rights and involuntary commitment
- NAMIWalks fundraising events
- Mental Health Awareness Month
- Youth and young adult mental health (NAMI Next Gen)
- Healthcare professional resilience
- Stigma reduction (StigmaFree campaign)
- Mental Health Professional Shortage Areas (HPSAs)
- Policy advocacy and legislative action
- Treatment access and healthcare equity
- Family support and education
- Media partnerships and public awareness

## Mental Health Conditions & Support

- [Types of Conditions | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/types-of-conditions): Overview of mental health conditions and their impact on daily living
- [What to Look For and When to Act | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/kids-teens-and-young-adults/kids-and-parents/what-to-look-for-and-when-to-act): Guide for parents on child mental health warning signs and intervention
- [Legal Support FAQ | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/faq/legal-support-faq): FAQ on patient rights, filing complaints, and mental health facility abuse

## Advocacy & Awareness Campaigns

- [NAMIWalks](https://www.nami.org/namiwalks): NAMIWalks fundraising and mental health awareness community events
- [Awareness Events | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/stay-connected/events/awareness-events): Annual mental health awareness events including Mental Health Month
- [NAMI Next Gen Alumni | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/who-we-are/meet-nami-next-gen/nami-next-gen-alumni): NAMI Next Gen alumni directory and youth leadership network

## Criminal Justice & Crisis Intervention

- [Help Not Handcuffs | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/crisis-intervention/webinars/help-not-handcuffs): Webinar series on crisis intervention and jail diversion programs
- [Overlooked: Stories of Mental Illness & the Criminal Justice System | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/advocate-for-change/overlooked-stories-of-mental-illness-the-criminal-justice-system): Personal stories highlighting mental illness in criminal justice system
- [Mental Health Treatment While Incarcerated | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/policy-positions/improving-health/mental-health-treatment-while-incarcerated): Policy on mental health treatment and solitary confinement in prisons

## Policy Positions & Healthcare Access

- [Workforce: Scholarship and Loan Repayment Programs | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/policy-positions/improving-health/workforce-scholarship-and-loan-repayment-programs): NAMI policy on scholarships and loan repayment for mental health workers
- [Involuntary Civil Commitment | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/policy-positions/improving-health/involuntary-civil-commitment): NAMI policy position on involuntary commitment and AOT as last resort
- [Medical Professionals: Licensure Application Questions on Mental Health | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/advocacy-at-nami/policy-positions/improving-health/medical-professionals-licensure-application-questions-on-mental-health): Policy on mental health questions in medical licensure applications

## Healthcare Professional Resources

- [Building Resilience | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/frontline-professionals/health-care-professionals/building-resilience): Resilience and stress management strategies for healthcare professionals

## Media & Communications

- [Press & Media | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/press-and-media): NAMI newsroom with press releases and media partnership resources
- [NAMI PSAs | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/press-and-media/nami-psas): Public service announcements and StigmaFree media resources for download

## Optional

- [Messaging Services | NAMI](https://www.nami.org/terms-of-use/messaging-services): SMS opt-in terms for NAMI advocacy alerts and text messaging services
